purpose: Tenth follow-up register. After CDR-001 publish closure, this round performs a line-level re-verification of Codex's key deliverables (PyFluent workflow, 2026-05-15 review package, codex-docs knowledge base) directly against current mainline source rather than trusting prior-round summaries. reconfirmed_closures.reconfirm_summary: Line-level read of HEAD:sim/pyfluent_workflow.py confirms the dry-run, manifest, validation_chain, and boundary allow-list guardrails are real code, not documentation claims. The mainline integration is a substantive hardening of the Codex draft, not a plain cherry-pick.

The four code-level findings Codex raised on 2026-05-15 (combined_losses return semantics, freq_max_hz enforcement, iron/copper ratio statistics, flux LUT pole_pairs validation) are all resolved on current mainline, confirming Codex's review drove real fixes.

items.title: origin/HEAD default branch (codex-review-line) is stale at 2026-05-13 and lacks PyFluent + the 2026-05-15 review package
items.finding: origin/HEAD resolves to origin/codex-review-line, i.e. it is the repository default branch a fresh clone checks out. That remote branch is frozen at cfda256 (2026-05-13) and does NOT contain sim/pyfluent_workflow.py or codex-review/docs/claude_development_review_2026-05-15.md (verified with git cat-file -e). The local codex-review-line is 4 commits ahead (4e0c489 PyFluent, 69b40b4 + dd47e70 + 6b137bf the 2026-05-15 review package). The content-equivalent of these commits already reached origin through claude-mainline (hardened PyFluent + migrated review package), so this is NOT data-loss risk. But because the stale branch is origin/HEAD, every fresh clone presents a 16-day-old Codex view that omits Codex's own headline deliverables. The current-version handoff reports effective_open_count=0 and remote-aligned, which is true only for claude-mainline and is silent on the default-branch staleness; this is a scope-of-claim gap, not a falsehood.
items.next_action: Per branch_integration_strategy.md, either publish codex-review-line to origin (preferred, since it is origin/HEAD), or repoint origin/HEAD to claude-mainline and explicitly document that origin/codex-review-line is superseded. Until then, the current handoff should scope its 'remote-aligned / effective_open=0' claim to claude-mainline rather than implying the whole remote is current. Do not reuse OPUS-2026-05-25-CDR-002 for this item because that older worktree-hygiene item was closed by r07.
